errors.generic: The service gave an unexpected answer. Please try again, and contact the Afriklang team if it keeps happening.
errors.notLinked: Open the link from your invitation email to get started.
errors.notAssigned: You are not part of this campaign.
errors.invalidLink: This invitation link is no longer valid: it may have been replaced by a newer invitation or cancelled. Use the link in your latest invitation email, or ask the Afriklang team for a new one.
errors.linkExpired: This invitation link has expired (links last 14 days). Ask the Afriklang team for a new invitation.
errors.emailUnverified: Sign in with a Google account whose email is verified.
errors.emailMismatch: Sign in with the Google account that uses the email address your invitation was sent to.
errors.accountConflict: This invitation belongs to a different account, or your account is already linked to another contributor. Contact the Afriklang team.
errors.consentChanged: The consent text has changed. Please read it again.
errors.alreadySubmitted: This mission already has a different recording, so this one was not saved. Go back to your missions.
errors.recordingRejected: This recording does not meet the requirements. Please record it again.
errors.blocked: This campaign is not available for your profile. The team has been told.
errors.accountConsent: Please accept the account consent first.
errors.campaignConsent: Please accept the campaign consent first.
errors.partnerConsent: Your conversation partner has not finished their consent yet.
errors.campaignPaused: Recording is paused. It reopens when the campaign resumes.
errors.campaignNotOpen: This campaign is not accepting recordings.
errors.serverError: The campaign service had a problem on its side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.unreachable: The service is not reachable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the information sent was not accepted. Check what you entered and try again. If it keeps happening, contact the Afriklang team.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet, then try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.misconfigured: The campaign service is not set up correctly. Please tell the Afriklang team.
errors.conflict: This was changed in the meantime. Reload the page, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests. Wait {s, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}, then try again.
errors.duplicateAudio: This recording was already sent for another prompt, so it was not saved. Record this prompt again.
errors.testClosed: This test is closed: your recordings are being reviewed, or the test has ended.

pool.batchDone: Nothing left to record in your batch. Get more missions to keep going.
pool.drawFailed: We could not get new missions. Check your connection and try again.
pool.clockWrong: Your phone's date or time looks wrong, so new missions seem to expire at once. Set the date and time to automatic in your phone's settings, then try again.
pool.leaseUntil: Record these by {date}. Missions not sent by then go to other speakers.
pool.leaseSoon: {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} left to record these. Missions not sent in time go to other speakers.
pool.leaseRow: {n, plural, one {# hour left} other {# hours left}}

cell_full.title: Enough recordings from your profile
cell_full.body: This campaign has enough recordings from speakers with your profile. Thank you! Finish the ones you have.

campaign_full.title: This campaign is complete
campaign_full.body: This campaign has all the recordings it needs. Thank you! Finish the ones you have.

speaker_cap.title: You have reached the limit
speaker_cap.body: You have reached the most one speaker may record in this campaign. Thank you!

quality_hold.title: New missions are on hold
quality_hold.body: Too many of your recent recordings were rejected. The team has been told and will be in touch.

pool.giveBack: Give back the missions I will not record
pool.giveBackHelp: They go to other speakers at once. You can get new ones later.
pool.giveBackConfirm: Give back {n, plural, one {# mission} other {# missions}}? They go to other speakers.
pool.givenBack: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing was given back.} one {# mission given back.} other {# missions given back.}}
pool.giveBackFailed: We could not give the missions back. Try again.

paid.help: You are paid for each hour of accepted audio.

notFoundPage.title: This page does not exist
notFoundPage.body: The link may be old or incomplete. Your missions and the recordings on this phone are safe.

offlinePage.title: You are offline
offlinePage.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Your missions and the recordings waiting to be sent are safe.

rejection.level: Too quiet, too loud or too noisy. Find a quiet place, speak in your normal voice and hold the phone about 20 cm away.
rejection.duration: Too short or too long for this prompt.
rejection.silence: The silence was not right: wait for “Speak now”, read without long pauses, and stay silent a moment at the end.
rejection.variety: This recording did not match the campaign's language variety. The team will contact you.
rejection.banned_topic: This recording touches a topic the campaign does not allow.
rejection.reading_gap: The recording does not match the sentence. Read it exactly as written.
rejection.speaker_balance: One voice took almost all of the conversation. Both of you should speak about as much.
rejection.other: This take could not be accepted.

too_short.title: Too short
too_short.measured: It lasted {measured} s; this prompt needs at least {limit} s.
too_short.fix: Watch the timer on screen and keep speaking until you reach the length it shows.

too_long.title: Too long
too_long.measured: It lasted {measured} s; the limit is {limit} s.
too_long.fix: Keep to the time shown on screen. For a free answer, a few sentences are enough.

low_snr.title: Your voice was not clear above the background
low_snr.measured: Your voice was {measured} dB above the background noise; we need at least {limit} dB.
low_snr.fix: Move to a quiet room, turn off fans, TV and music, and hold the phone about 20 cm from your mouth.

background_noise.title: Too much background noise
background_noise.measured: The background noise was at {measured} dBFS; it must stay below {limit} dBFS.
background_noise.fix: Find a quieter place, away from the street, other voices and machines, then record again.

clipping.title: Too loud: the sound was distorted
clipping.measured: {measured} of the sound was saturated; the limit is {limit}.
clipping.fix: Hold the phone a little further away (about 20 cm) and speak at your normal volume, without shouting.

long_silence.title: Too many long pauses
long_silence.measured: {measured} of the recording was silence between your first and last word; the limit is {limit}.
long_silence.fix: Read the prompt and prepare your answer before pressing Record, then speak without long breaks.

wrong_format.title: The file could not be used
wrong_format.measured: The recording was not in the format we need.
wrong_format.fix: Record it again in the app. If it happens again, update the app or try another phone.

processing_failed.title: We could not process this recording
processing_failed.measured: Our system could not read this recording. This is not your fault.
